description:
An attractive three-bedroom terraced house located just a stone's throw away from the city centre. The property boasts a generously sized open-plan living, dining, and kitchen area, perfect for entertaining or relaxing with family and friends. Featuring a convenient ground floor shower room and a first-floor bathroom, this home offers practicality and comfort. Step outside to find a rear yard complete with a useful outbuilding and parking space for a small car, adding to the property's appeal. Nestled in a sought-after area to the west of the city centre, residents can enjoy easy access to a variety of amenities. This property presents an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers or investors seeking a buy-to-let option, as it comes to market with no onward chain. While some refurbishment is needed, this presents a chance for the new owners to personalise the property and unlock its full potential. Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity to create a comfortable and conveniently located home.

Directions From the Hardwicke Circus west passing the castle and at the traffic lights turn left. On reaching the lights at the foot of Dixons Chimney, number 68 is on the right hand side before the Newcastle Street junction.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.
